quotes.name: Clarissa Dane
quotes.quote: I feel like there's something missing in the way my episode is being reported, it doesn't quite capture the complexity of what's going on in Fruitvale. I think the Tribune should ask more questions about how the community is really being affected.

quotes.name: Rick Walker
quotes.quote: I feel like something's off about this whole Clarissa Dane thing, it's just a vibe I get when I'm out and about in Fruitvale, and I think the Tribune should ask what's really going on behind the scenes.

quotes.name: Rafael Pilgrim
quotes.quote: I'm not sure what to make of this Clarissa Dane's UNDOCKED episode, it just feels off, like something isn't being said, and I think the Tribune should ask what's really going on behind the scenes.

quotes.name: Tomas Renteria
quotes.quote: I feel like something's off about Clarissa Dane's UNDOCKED episode because it doesn't seem to be settling in with people around here, and I think the Tribune should ask what's really going on beneath the surface.
